note: Temple stone fades slowly so gilded trim still reads at the far wall.
Forest canopy haze starts close but stays thin, keeping the tree line soft behind the fighters.
Catacomb mist is deep and narrow so violet cracks keep contrast without flooding the hall.
Storm ridge haze is the thinnest, letting distant peaks stay legible.
Obsidian ember light keeps a wide falloff so the black steps do not swallow the horizon.
